question: Which problems exceed the total number of times they appear in the solution table when counting all occurrences, across steps 1, 2, and 3, where any non-"Stack" model's maximum test score is lower than the "Stack" model's test score for the same step and version?
sql:
WITH cond_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        name,
        COUNT(*) as condition_count
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            name, version, step,
            MAX(CASE WHEN model = 'Stack' THEN test_score END) as stack_score,
            MAX(CASE WHEN model != 'Stack' THEN test_score END) as max_nonstack_score
        FROM model_score
        WHERE step IN (1, 2, 3)
        GROUP BY name, version, step
        HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN model = 'Stack' THEN test_score END) IS NOT NULL
           AND MAX(CASE WHEN model != 'Stack' THEN test_score END) IS NOT NULL
    ) sub
    WHERE max_nonstack_score < stack_score
    GROUP BY name
),
sol_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        name,
        COUNT(*) as solution_count
    FROM solution
    GROUP BY name
)
SELECT 
    p.name,
    COALESCE(c.condition_count, 0) as condition_count,
    COALESCE(s.solution_count, 0) as solution_count,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.condition_count, 0) > COALESCE(s.solution_count, 0) THEN 'EXCEEDS' ELSE 'no' END as exceeds
FROM problem p
LEFT JOIN cond_counts c ON p.name = c.name
LEFT JOIN sol_counts s ON p.name = s.name
ORDER BY p.name
